Not long ago my coworkers called me the 'boy genius trader' — every morning someone asked what I was buying next.
One record-breaking red candle on the futures overnight demoted me from god back to mortal, then kept going until I owed money.
Nobody asks me for tips anymore. Now they just ask, 'Hey, are you okay?'
en.editorNote: For everyone who used to be the group chat's guru and has quietly gone silent lately
variations: From trading god to trader takes one red candle. From trader to debtor takes one more.
My title updates fast: yesterday boy genius, today boy in debt.

items.sourceNote: PTT「別人恐懼我貪婪，別人小虧我破產」反諷名言 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
巴菲特說：別人恐懼我貪婪，別人貪婪我恐懼。
我認真照做，把這句話貼在螢幕上每天看。
執行成果：別人恐懼的時候，我也恐懼；別人貪婪的時候，我才終於貪婪。
所以我永遠慢半拍，恐懼接在最低點，貪婪接在最高點，全程精準錯開。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個把投資名言背得滾瓜爛熟、實際操作卻完全相反的同好
variations: 名言我都會背，只是市場不照名言走，我也不照名言做。
別人恐懼我貪婪這句話很對，只可惜我總是先恐懼完，才想起要貪婪。

en.content:
Buffett said: be greedy when others are fearful, fearful when others are greedy.
I took it seriously and taped it to my monitor.
Execution results: when others were fearful, I was fearful too; only once everyone got greedy did I finally feel brave.
So I'm always one beat late — catching fear at the bottom, greed at the top, perfectly out of sync the whole way.
en.editorNote: For everyone who has the investing quotes memorized and does the exact opposite in practice
variations: I can recite every famous quote. The market just doesn't follow them, and neither do I.
'Be greedy when others are fearful' is great advice. Shame I always finish being fearful right before I remember to be greedy.

items.sourceNote: PTT「庫存綠到有牛在上面吃草」幹話語錄 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
朋友問我最近持股顏色怎麼樣。
我說綠的，很環保的那種綠。
綠到我懷疑帳戶裡長出了草原，再過幾天可能會有牛跑進來吃草。
我這不是在投資，我是在經營一座生態保護區。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在收盤後對著一片綠油油的對帳單苦中作樂時發
variations: 我的庫存綠到可以申請成為國家公園。
別人的紅燈是賺錢，我的綠燈是養草，各有各的收成。

en.content:
A friend asked what color my holdings are these days.
I said green — the eco-friendly kind.
So green I suspect a meadow has sprouted in my account, and in a few days a cow might wander in to graze.
I'm not running a portfolio. I'm running a nature reserve.
en.editorNote: For making the best of it while staring at a wall of green after the close
variations: My holdings are green enough to apply for national park status.
Other people's red means profit. My green means I'm growing grass. Different harvests, I suppose.

items.sourceNote: 「buy the dip → bottomless pit」自嘲 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
理財文章教我：別怕震盪，逢低買進就對了。
於是震盪來了，我逢低買進。
再來一個震盪，我又逢低買進。
買到後來我才發現，我以為的那個低，其實沒有底——它不是一個價位，是一個無底洞，而我把全部家當都丟進去填它。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合貼在每次想加碼攤平、覺得『這次真的是最低了』的那一秒
variations: 我不是在逢低買進，我是在填一個永遠填不滿的洞。
震盪是市場給有勇氣的人的禮物，我收了一堆禮物，現在禮物比本金多。

en.content:
The finance blog taught me: don't fear volatility, just buy the dip.
So the volatility came, and I bought the dip.
Another shake, and I bought the dip again.
Eventually I realized the dip I kept buying had no floor — it wasn't a price, it was a bottomless pit, and I'd thrown my entire net worth in trying to fill it.
en.editorNote: Read this the second you decide to average down because 'this really has to be the bottom'
variations: I'm not buying the dip. I'm filling a hole that can never be filled.
Volatility is the market's gift to the brave. I collected a pile of gifts. Now I have more gifts than capital.

items.sourceNote: 槓桿 / 高槓桿融資斷頭 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
我開了融資，因為我相信這檔一定漲，槓桿開下去報酬翻倍。
結果它沒漲，跌了。
槓桿很公平，它把報酬翻倍，也把虧損翻倍，最後連我的本金一起翻走了。
我這才懂，槓桿不是放大鏡，是離心機——把我跟我的錢，甩到兩個不同的方向。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個被『開槓桿才賺得快』推坑、結果先被斷頭的勇者
variations: 槓桿讓我用兩倍的速度，抵達原本要好幾年才會破產的地方。
我以為槓桿是加速器，它確實是，只是加速的方向是往下。

en.content:
I took out margin because I was sure this one would rip — lever up and double the returns.
It didn't rip. It dropped.
Margin is fair: it doubled the gains, doubled the losses, and in the end doubled my principal right out the door.
That's when I understood leverage isn't a magnifying glass, it's a centrifuge — it flung me and my money in two different directions.
en.editorNote: For the brave soul talked into 'you only get rich fast with leverage' who got margin-called first
variations: Leverage let me reach, at double speed, a bankruptcy that would otherwise have taken years.
I thought leverage was an accelerator. It was — the direction it accelerated me was straight down.

items.sourceNote: 2026 台股投機狂熱超越基本面 / 投機情緒指數 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
分析師說：現在這個盤已經完全脫離基本面了。
我看了看自己的持股，鬆了一口氣。
還好我從頭到尾都沒看過基本面，所以我跟這個盤一直保持同步。
別人是後來才脫離基本面，我是天生的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在新聞狂喊『投機過熱』、自己卻早就 all in 的盤中自嘲
variations: 市場脫離基本面的那一天，我才發現我跟市場終於有了共同點。
他們擔心估值太高，我擔心的是我連估值怎麼算都不知道。

en.content:
The analyst said: this market has completely detached from fundamentals.
I looked at my holdings and breathed a sigh of relief.
Good thing I never looked at the fundamentals to begin with, so I've stayed perfectly in sync with the market the whole time.
Other people detached from fundamentals recently. I was born this way.
en.editorNote: For the intraday self-roast when the news screams 'overheated speculation' and you went all in weeks ago
variations: The day the market detached from fundamentals was the day I realized we finally had something in common.
They worry the valuations are too high. I worry that I don't even know how valuation is calculated.

items.sourceNote: PTT 博士生拆解郭哲榮 2953 篇發文 / 名嘴反指標 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
有人說某個名嘴是反指標，他喊買就跌，他喊賣就漲。
我聽了很興奮，決定每次都跟他反著做。
結果這次他改喊『先觀望』，我整個人愣在原地，不知道反向是哪個方向。
反指標最可怕的地方，是他偶爾會講對一次，剛好就是你跟他反著做的那一次。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個把名嘴當反指標、結果還是被坑的同好
variations: 我不聽明牌，我只聽反指標，但反指標居然也有反指標的時候。
跟著名嘴買會賠，跟他反著做也會賠，因為他知道你會反著做。

en.content:
People say a certain TV pundit is a contrarian indicator — he says buy, it drops; he says sell, it rips.
I got excited and decided to fade him every single time.
Then he switched to 'let's wait and see,' and I froze, not knowing which way the opposite of that even is.
The scariest thing about a reverse indicator is that he gets it right once in a while — usually the exact time you faded him.
en.editorNote: For everyone who treats a TV pundit as a contrarian signal and still got burned
variations: I don't follow hot tips. I only follow contrarian indicators. Turns out even the contrarian indicator has off days.
Following the pundit loses money. Fading him loses money too, because he knows you'll fade him.

items.sourceNote: 2026 融資餘額暴增 / 違約交割頻傳 register；改寫原創 (避開個資、純自嘲)

zh-tw.content:
新聞說最近違約交割頻傳，散戶玩太大了。
我看完默默把下單金額改小，從『梭哈』改成『小梭』。
我不是變謹慎了，我是發現自己的本金，連違約都不夠資格違約。
原來想被市場教訓得轟轟烈烈，也是要有門檻的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在新聞報違約交割、自己看著小小的本金苦笑時發
variations: 別人違約交割上新聞，我違約交割連帳戶都懶得通知我。
我的本金太少，少到連爆倉都顯得很低調。

en.content:
The news says default settlements are spiking — retail traders are betting way too big.
I quietly shrank my order size, downgrading from 'all in' to 'a modest in.'
It's not that I got cautious. I just realized my principal isn't even big enough to qualify for a default.
Turns out getting spectacularly schooled by the market has a minimum buy-in too.
en.editorNote: For the bitter laugh when the news reports settlement defaults and you look at your tiny account balance
variations: Other people's defaults make the headlines. My default isn't worth a notification from my own broker.
My principal is so small that even blowing up the account feels understated.

items.sourceNote: 「make a million: invest two million」/ 「trade to fund my therapy」register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
朋友問我：在股市賺到一百萬的秘訣是什麼？
我說很簡單，先準備兩百萬。
他以為我在開玩笑，但我真的就是這樣，先丟兩百萬進去，現在剩一百萬。
你看，我說到做到，我真的『賺到』一百萬——的存款餘額。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個賠到一半、還能笑著算數學的同好
variations: 在股市要變成小富翁，最快的方法就是先當大富翁再進場。
我沒有賠錢，我只是把兩百萬精簡成更精緻的一百萬。

en.content:
A friend asked me the secret to making a million in the stock market.
I said it's easy: start with two million.
He thought I was joking, but that's literally my strategy — throw in two million, and now I have one million left.
See? I'm a man of my word. I really did 'make' one million — in remaining balance.
en.editorNote: For everyone down 50 percent who can still laugh while doing the math
variations: The fastest way to become a small fortune in the market is to walk in with a large fortune.
I didn't lose money. I just streamlined two million into a more refined one million.

items.sourceNote: 「buy high, sell low, cry often」交易三部曲 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
都說交易很簡單：買低、賣高，賺價差。
我也學會了，只是我的版本順序有點不一樣：買高、賣低，然後哭。
前兩步我做得行雲流水，毫不猶豫；第三步更是熟練到不用看教學。
別人三步驟賺錢，我三步驟修身養性。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在收盤後把當天的失誤從頭數一遍時，配著一口熱湯服用
variations: 交易其實只有三個動作：買、賣、後悔，而我後悔的部分特別有天分。
買低賣高是理想，買高賣低是日常，哭是售後服務。

en.content:
They say trading is simple: buy low, sell high, pocket the difference.
I learned it too, my version's order is just a little different: buy high, sell low, then cry.
The first two steps I execute flawlessly, no hesitation. The third I've mastered so well I don't even need a tutorial.
Other people use three steps to make money. I use three steps for personal growth.
en.editorNote: For tallying up the day's mistakes after the close, best taken with a bowl of hot soup
variations: Trading is really just three moves: buy, sell, regret. I happen to be exceptionally gifted at the regret part.
Buy low sell high is the dream. Buy high sell low is the routine. Crying is the after-sales service.

items.sourceNote: 6/24 外資單日賣超1774億創史上最大 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
新聞：「外資單日狂賣一千七百多億，刷新史上最大賣超紀錄。」
我看著那個數字想了想：原來我接的不是飛刀，是外資出清的整座倉庫。
他們搬空一間倉庫只要一天，我搬回家卻要扛一輩子。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在外資爆量提款那天，配著綠到發黑的對帳單一起看
variations: 外資創史上最大賣超那天，我貢獻了其中很微小但很真誠的一筆買進。
他們賣超創紀錄，我套牢也創紀錄，這天我們各自寫下了歷史。

en.content:
Headline: 'Foreign funds dump a record amount in a single day, the largest net sell in history.'
I stared at the number and thought: turns out I wasn't catching a falling knife, I was catching an entire warehouse the foreigners were clearing out.
It took them one day to empty the warehouse. It'll take me a lifetime to haul it home.
en.editorNote: For the day foreign funds yank a record amount out — best paired with a statement so green it's nearly black
variations: On the day foreign funds set the all-time net-sell record, I contributed one tiny but very sincere buy order.
They set a record for selling. I set a record for being stuck. That day we each made history.

items.sourceNote: 台股單日暴跌近1500點 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
大盤單日跌了快一千五百點，群組裡瞬間安靜得像清明節。
有人問現在該怎麼辦，沒人回。
不是不想回，是大家都在忙著把對帳單關掉，假裝今天沒開盤。
我們不是不勇敢，我們只是學會了一種新的求生技能——不看就不痛。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個在崩盤日把券商 APP 直接刪掉、晚上又默默裝回來的同好
variations: 崩盤那天我最大的成就，是忍住沒打開對帳單，撐到了隔天早上。
跌一千五百點的時候，全世界都很吵，只有我的投資群組安靜得可怕。

en.content:
The index dropped almost 1,500 points in a single day, and the group chat went silent as a funeral home.
Someone asked what we should do now. Nobody answered.
It's not that we didn't want to. We were all busy closing the app and pretending the market never opened today.
We're not cowards. We just learned a new survival skill — if you don't look, it doesn't hurt.
en.editorNote: For everyone who deleted the broker app on crash day and quietly reinstalled it that night
variations: My biggest achievement on crash day was resisting the urge to open my statement until the next morning.
When the index fell 1,500 points the whole world was loud. Only my investing group chat went terrifyingly quiet.

items.sourceNote: 融資餘額暴增 / 違約交割頻傳 / 槓桿過高 register；改寫原創 (避開個股)

zh-tw.content:
我以為我用融資是在放大獲利。
後來才發現，融資真正放大的，是我每天早上醒來的那一聲嘆氣。
本金跌一成我心痛，融資讓我用一成的本金，痛到十成那麼飽滿。
槓桿確實很有效，它精準地把我的小焦慮，槓成了大失眠。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個用融資開大、結果半夜被追繳通知嚇醒的勇者，提醒自己量力而為
variations: 融資的意思是，連你還沒賠的那部分，市場都先幫你借來賠掉。
別人用槓桿撬動財富，我用槓桿撬動了我的血壓。

en.content:
I thought using margin was amplifying my gains.
Later I realized what margin really amplifies is the sigh I let out every morning when I wake up.
A 10 percent drop on cash already hurts. Margin let me feel that pain at a full 100 percent intensity off just 10 percent of my own money.
Leverage really works — it precisely levered my small anxiety into a giant case of insomnia.
en.editorNote: For the brave soul who maxed out on margin and got jolted awake by a margin call at 3 a.m. — know your limits
variations: Margin means the market lets you borrow and lose the part you hadn't even lost yet.
Other people use leverage to move wealth. I used leverage to move my blood pressure.

items.sourceNote: 本益比數十倍 / 投機脫鉤基本面 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
分析師說這檔本益比幾十倍，已經完全脫離基本面。
我聽了點點頭，然後還是買了。
因為我發現，在這個市場，看基本面的人都在場邊看，看題材的人都在場上飛。
等我終於想通要回去看基本面的時候，基本面正在我的成本價下面，跟我招手。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在被熱門題材股 FOMO、又怕本益比太高時，提醒自己保持清醒
variations: 本益比幾十倍我不怕，反正我買的時候沒在看『益』，我只看『漲』。
別人問我這檔基本面如何，我說我不知道，我只知道它今天漲停。

en.content:
The analyst said this one's trading at dozens of times earnings, completely detached from fundamentals.
I nodded thoughtfully, then bought it anyway.
Because I've noticed that in this market, the people watching fundamentals are watching from the sidelines, and the people chasing the story are the ones flying.
By the time I finally come around to checking fundamentals again, they'll be waving at me from somewhere below my cost basis.
en.editorNote: For the moment you're FOMO'd into a hot-theme stock but worried the multiple is insane — stay sober
variations: A P/E of fifty doesn't scare me. When I bought it I wasn't looking at the 'E,' just the green.
Someone asked about this stock's fundamentals. I said I don't know, I only know it's limit-up today.

items.sourceNote: 「buy the dip… now I live there」register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
他們說逢低買進，於是我買了那個低點。
結果那個低點下面還有低點，再下面還有低點，一層一層往下。
買到後來我發現，我不只是來逢低買進的，我是直接搬進來，在這個低點定居了。
現在這裡是我家，門牌號碼是『成本價』，地址是『回不去』。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個一路逢低買進、最後乾脆住進谷底的同好，貼在群組會心一笑
variations: 逢低買進的盡頭，是把谷底裝潢成自己的家。
我本來只是路過這個低點，現在我在這裡繳房貸了。

en.content:
They said buy the dip, so I bought the dip.
Turns out there was a dip below that dip, and another dip below that one, layer after layer heading down.
Eventually I realized I didn't just come to buy the dip — I moved in. I've settled down here at the bottom.
This is home now. The unit number is 'cost basis,' and the address is 'no way back.'
en.editorNote: For everyone who bought every dip and finally just moved into the basement — share for a knowing smile
variations: The end of buying the dip is renovating the bottom into your forever home.
I was only passing through this dip. Now I'm paying a mortgage down here.

items.sourceNote: PTT 股板「庫存綠到有牛在上面吃草」經典幹話 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
朋友問我最近庫存還好嗎。
我說還好，綠油油的，一片生機盎然。
他說那不錯啊。
我說對啊，綠到我都看到有一頭牛，在我的庫存上面悠閒地吃草了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個對帳單綠到發慌、只能用幽默自救的同好，貼在群組互相取暖
variations: 我的庫存不是賠，是在發展一片永續的綠色生態。
別人的庫存紅紅火火，我的庫存綠草如茵，適合野餐。

en.content:
A friend asked how my positions were doing lately.
I said pretty good — nice and green, full of life.
He said that sounds great.
I said yeah, so green I can see a cow up there, grazing peacefully on top of my portfolio.
en.editorNote: For everyone whose statement is green enough to panic over and who can only cope with humor — share in the group chat
variations: My portfolio isn't down. It's cultivating a sustainable green ecosystem.
Other people's positions are blazing red. Mine are a lush green meadow, perfect for a picnic.

items.sourceNote: 「別人恐懼我貪婪，別人小虧我破產」改編巴菲特名言 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
巴菲特說：別人恐懼時我貪婪，別人貪婪時我恐懼。
我把這句話奉為圭臬，認真執行了好幾年。
執行結果是：別人小虧的時候，我已經破產；別人大賺的時候，我還在場邊恐懼。
看來名言要會用，不是會背。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在抄了一堆投資金句卻越做越賠的時候，提醒自己金句不等於獲利
variations: 我很會在別人恐懼時貪婪，只是我永遠抓不準別人到底有沒有在恐懼。
投資金句我背得滾瓜爛熟，帳戶卻一點都不熟。

en.content:
Buffett said: be greedy when others are fearful, and fearful when others are greedy.
I made it my gospel and followed it faithfully for years.
The result: by the time others were taking small losses, I was already bankrupt; by the time others were raking it in, I was still on the sidelines, afraid.
Turns out a great quote is something you use, not just memorize.
en.editorNote: For when you've collected a hundred investing quotes and somehow keep losing — a quote is not a return
variations: I'm great at being greedy when others are fearful. I just can never tell whether they're actually fearful.
I know every investing quote by heart. My account, not so much.

items.sourceNote: 「charts look like modern art」IG caption register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
我打開那檔股票的線圖，整個人愣了三秒。
紅的綠的長的短的，雜亂無章地擠在一起，看不出任何規律。
後來我想通了：這不是 K 線圖，這是一幅抽象藝術。
難怪我看不懂——因為它本來就不是要給人看懂的，是要給人感受痛的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在盯著一團亂的線圖、怎麼看都看不出方向時自嘲
variations: 我看不懂這張線圖，但我看得懂我帳戶的眼淚。
別人的 K 線是技術分析，我的 K 線是當代藝術，重點在於意境。

en.content:
I pulled up the chart and froze for three seconds.
Reds, greens, long ones, short ones, all crammed together with no pattern in sight.
Then it clicked: this isn't a candlestick chart, it's a piece of abstract art.
No wonder I can't read it — it was never meant to be understood, only to be felt, painfully.
en.editorNote: For staring at a chaotic chart that refuses to show you any direction no matter how long you look
variations: I can't read this chart, but I can read the tears in my account.
Other people's candles are technical analysis. Mine are contemporary art — it's all about the vibe.

items.sourceNote: 「反指標 / 名人喊單反著做」郭哲榮反指標 register；改寫原創 (不指名真人)

zh-tw.content:
群組裡有一個人，每次喊買，那檔股票隔天必跌；每次喊賣，那檔股票隔天必漲。
後來大家發現，他根本是一座精準到嚇人的反指標燈塔。
於是全群組開始反著他做，個個都賺。
直到有一天他默默退群——因為他發現那座反指標燈塔，其實是我們大家合起來的平均。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個群組裡都有的那位「反指標」朋友，貼上去前先確認自己不是那一位
variations: 市場上最準的指標，是某個朋友的信心。他越有信心，你就越要小心。
我不是反指標，我只是剛好每次都站在對的反面。

en.content:
There's a guy in the group chat: every time he calls a buy, the stock drops the next day; every time he calls a sell, it rips the next day.
Eventually everyone realized he's a terrifyingly accurate contrarian beacon.
So the whole chat started fading him, and everyone started winning.
Until one day he quietly left — because he figured out that the contrarian beacon was just the average of all of us combined.
en.editorNote: For the resident 'reverse indicator' friend every group chat has — make sure you're not the one before posting
variations: The most accurate signal in the market is a certain friend's confidence. The surer he is, the more careful you should be.
I'm not a contrarian indicator. I just happen to stand on the wrong side every single time.

items.sourceNote: 「38萬新散戶6月進場後暴跌套牢 / 主力不跟散戶同方向」register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
新聞說，這個月有三十八萬個新散戶勇敢進場。
我就是那三十八萬分之一。
進場第三天，大盤開始暴跌，我才明白一件事：
原來我們三十八萬人，不是來投資的，是主力等了很久、終於等到的那批人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個看到「新增散戶創新高」新聞、剛好自己也是其中一個的新手，貼在群組互相取暖
variations: 統計數字裡的三十八萬人很風光，那三十八萬份對帳單很安靜。
我進場的時機，剛好就是別人準備離場的時機。

en.content:
The news said 380,000 brave new retail investors piled in this month.
I'm one of those 380,000.
Day three after I entered, the market started crashing, and it hit me:
We weren't 380,000 investors. We were the crowd the whales had been patiently waiting for all along.
en.editorNote: For every newcomer who saw the 'record new retail accounts' headline and realized they were one of them — share in the chat for mutual comfort
variations: The 380,000 look glorious in the statistics. Those 380,000 account statements are very quiet.
The moment I decided to get in was exactly the moment everyone else decided to get out.

items.sourceNote: 「risk tolerance so high my portfolio is a non-profit」register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
銀行做風險評估，問我能承受多大的波動。
我照實填了，系統跳出結果：積極型投資人。
我照著積極型的建議操作了一年。
現在我的帳戶已經不能算是投資組合了，比較像一個長期虧損的慈善機構——只出不進，還很穩定。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在做完風險屬性評估、被歸類成「積極型」後自嘲
variations: 我的風險承受度高到，我的帳戶已經可以申請免稅了。
他們說高風險高報酬，我這邊只實現了前半句。

en.content:
The bank ran a risk assessment and asked how much volatility I could handle.
I answered honestly, and the system spat out: aggressive investor.
So I followed the aggressive playbook for a year.
Now my account doesn't really qualify as a portfolio anymore — it's more like a long-running charity that keeps losing money: all outflow, no inflow, remarkably consistent.
en.editorNote: For the self-deprecating moment after a risk questionnaire labels you 'aggressive'
variations: My risk tolerance is so high my account might qualify as tax-exempt.
They said high risk, high reward. I've only managed to deliver on the first half.

items.sourceNote: 「I tried day trading, now I need a day off」register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
我試著當沖，想說賺個買菜錢。
一天下來，眼睛乾了、脖子僵了、手心冒汗、心跳加速。
收盤結算：小賠。
我終於懂了，當沖不是一份工作，是一種需要另外請一天假來恢復的體力活。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在當沖一整天、身心俱疲卻沒賺到錢的傍晚分享
variations: 我當沖賺到的不是錢，是一個需要好好休息的下午。
當沖一天，回血三天，這報酬率我算過，不划算。

en.content:
I gave day trading a shot, figured I'd earn some grocery money.
By the end of one day: dry eyes, stiff neck, sweaty palms, racing heart.
Final tally at the close: a small loss.
Now I get it — day trading isn't a job, it's manual labor that requires taking a separate day off to recover from.
en.editorNote: For the evening after a full day of scalping that left you drained and no richer
variations: What I earned from day trading wasn't money. It was an afternoon I badly needed to spend resting.
One day of scalping, three days to recover. I ran the numbers on that return — not worth it.

items.sourceNote: 「端午變盤 / 節慶前後行情迷信」register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
老一輩的股友說，端午前後容易變盤，要小心。
我聽進去了，於是端午前先把持股全出。
結果連假一結束，大盤直接跳空大漲。
變盤是真的變了，只是變成——沒有我的那盤。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在每次聽信「節慶行情」的說法、卻剛好賣在起漲點時自嘲
variations: 股市裡最準的季節性規律，是我一避開就一定會漲。
我信了變盤的說法，變的是盤，賠的是我。

en.content:
The old-timers in the stock chat warned that the market tends to swing around the holiday, so be careful.
I took it to heart and dumped all my positions before the long weekend.
The moment the holiday ended, the index gapped up and ran.
The market did swing, all right — it swung right past the version with me in it.
en.editorNote: For the self-deprecating moment when you trusted a 'holiday seasonality' theory and sold right before the rally
variations: The most reliable seasonal pattern in the market is that it always rallies the moment I step aside.
I believed the swing was coming. The market swung, and I'm the one who paid for it.

items.sourceNote: 「別人恐懼我貪婪，別人小虧我破產」PTT 幹話語錄 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
巴菲特說：別人恐懼時我貪婪，別人貪婪時我恐懼。
我認真學了。
現在變成：別人小賠時我住套房，別人小賺時我住地下室。
我把大師的名言完美執行了，只是每一句都執行反了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個把投資大師名言貼在牆上、卻總是做反的同好，貼群組互相取暖
variations: 別人在山腳恐懼，我在山頂貪婪，這就是我跟大師唯一的差別。
名言我全都背得出來，只是輪到我做，句子就自己倒過來了。

en.content:
Buffett said: be greedy when others are fearful, fearful when others are greedy.
I studied hard.
Now it's: others take a small loss, I move into an underwater apartment; others take a small gain, I move into the basement.
I executed the master's words perfectly — I just executed every single one of them backwards.
en.editorNote: For everyone who taped a legendary investor's quote to the wall and still does the opposite. Share in the chat for mutual comfort
variations: Others are fearful at the bottom, I'm greedy at the top. That's the only difference between me and the master.
I can recite every famous quote. The moment it's my turn to act, the sentence flips itself around.

items.sourceNote: 「bag holder 最後接盤俠」register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
群組裡有人先發現一檔飆股，大家一窩蜂進場，然後又一窩蜂跑掉。
跑的時候，好像少算了一個人。
對，那個人是我。
我終於在這個市場找到一個永遠有我位置的角色——最後一個下車的人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個總是最後才知道要跑、結果被留下來抱著的接盤仔
variations: 大家都說會互相通知，結果通知我的時候，通常是叫我付帳。
我不是投資人，我是市場的資源回收站，專門收別人不要的股票。

en.content:
Someone in the group chat spotted a rocket, everyone piled in, then everyone piled out.
On the way out, it seemed like they forgot to count one person.
Yes, that person was me.
I finally found a role in this market that always has a seat with my name on it — the last one off the ride.
en.editorNote: For the bag holder who's always the last to hear it's time to run and ends up left holding it
variations: Everyone promised to give each other a heads-up. When they gave me one, it was usually to pay the tab.
I'm not an investor. I'm the market's recycling depot, specializing in the stocks nobody else wants.

items.sourceNote: 「庫存綠到有牛在上面吃草」PTT register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
有人問我最近庫存怎麼樣。
我說：綠。
他問：綠多少？
我說：綠到我打開對帳單，都會聞到一股青草香，還隱約聽見牛叫。
我的持股不是賠錢，是變成一片牧場。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在滿江綠的收盤傍晚，配著對帳單自嘲貼群組
variations: 我的庫存綠到可以拿去申請有機認證了。
別人的花園需要澆水，我的庫存自己就長成一片綠地。

en.content:
Someone asked how my holdings were doing lately.
I said: green.
They asked: how green?
I said: green enough that when I open my statement, I catch a whiff of fresh grass and faintly hear a cow moo.
My positions aren't down. They've turned into a pasture.
en.editorNote: For the deep-in-the-red evening after the close — pair with your statement for a self-deprecating group post
variations: My portfolio is green enough to qualify for organic certification.
Other people water their gardens. My holdings grow their own meadow all by themselves.

items.sourceNote: 「2026 半年報 賺錢沒什麼賠錢才厲害」阿呆半年報 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
上半年結束，我認真做了一份投資半年報。
賺錢那幾筆，一句話就寫完了。
賠錢那幾筆，我寫了三頁，附圖表、附時間軸、附心路歷程。
我終於發現我的專長：賺錢時很低調，賠錢時很會敘事。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在年中結算、發現虧損比獲利更有故事性的時候自嘲
variations: 我的半年報最精彩的部分，全部集中在負號後面。
賺錢是運氣，不用解釋；賠錢是實力，需要長篇論述。

en.content:
The first half of the year wrapped up, so I put together an honest six-month investing report.
The winning trades? One sentence covered them all.
The losing trades? Three pages, with charts, a timeline, and a full emotional journey.
I finally discovered my real talent: modest about the gains, deeply literary about the losses.
en.editorNote: For the mid-year review when you realize your losses have far better storytelling than your wins
variations: The most gripping part of my half-year report is entirely located after the minus signs.
Making money is luck, no explanation needed. Losing money is skill, and it requires a lengthy essay.

items.sourceNote: 「Some get rich studying AI, I make money studying natural stupidity」Icahn register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
有人研究人工智慧賺大錢。
我沒那個天分，只好研究天然的愚蠢。
研究了好幾年，終於找到一個最穩定、最好預測的樣本——就是每次都追高殺低的我自己。
這大概是我這輩子做過唯一命中率百分之百的研究。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個把自己當反指標、賠到看破一切的同好
variations: 別人靠 AI 選股，我靠觀察我自己的直覺，然後反著做。
我最了解的一檔標的，就是我自己，因為它每次都讓我賠錢。

en.content:
Some people get rich studying artificial intelligence.
I don't have the gift, so I settled for studying natural stupidity.
After years of research, I finally found the most stable, most predictable sample there is — me, buying every top and selling every bottom.
It's probably the only study of my life with a one-hundred-percent hit rate.
en.editorNote: For the investor who has become their own reliable contrarian indicator and made peace with it
variations: Other people pick stocks with AI. I observe my own gut instinct and then do the exact opposite.
The one asset I understand best is myself, because it loses me money every single time.

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content:
我發過一百次誓，跌破成本一定停損。
第一百零一次，我又跟自己說：「再撐一天，明天一定反彈。」
後來它真的反彈了——反彈完，繼續往下跌。
我不是沒有紀律，我只是把紀律用在等它跌得更深這件事上。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個把停損線當參考價、越攤越平的長期套牢戶
variations: 我的停損點很明確，就是等它跌到我不敢看的時候。
說好跌 10% 就跑，結果跌 50% 我還在幫它加油。

en.content:
I've sworn a hundred times I'd cut my losses the moment it dropped below cost.
The hundred-and-first time, I told myself, "Just one more day, it'll bounce tomorrow."
And it did bounce — then it kept right on falling.
It's not that I lack discipline. I just apply all of it to waiting for the thing to drop even lower.
en.editorNote: For the perpetually underwater holder who treats the stop-loss line as a suggestion
variations: My stop-loss is very precise: it's whenever the price gets too low for me to look at.
I said I'd sell at down 10%. At down 50% I'm still cheering it on.

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content:
我開始投資，是為了早點財富自由，不用再看老闆臉色。
三年過去，我不但沒自由，還多了一個新老闆——大盤。
它比我原本的老闆更難搞：不給薪水、隨時開會、還常常半夜叫我起來看盤。
至少原本的老闆，週末不會扣我錢。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個想靠投資逃離職場、結果被市場請去加班的上班族
variations: 本來想離職，現在多了一份不支薪的全職工作叫盯盤。
我沒有財富自由，只有財富焦慮，而且還是全年無休那種。

en.content:
I started investing so I could reach financial freedom and stop answering to a boss.
Three years later, I'm not free — I've just gained a new boss: the market.
It's tougher than my old one: no paycheck, meetings at all hours, and it wakes me up at 3 a.m. to check the charts.
At least my old boss didn't dock my pay on weekends.
en.editorNote: For the office worker who tried to escape their job through investing and got drafted into overtime by the market
variations: I wanted to quit my job. Instead I picked up a second, unpaid full-time job called watching the ticker.
I didn't get financial freedom, I got financial anxiety — the kind that never takes a day off.

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content:
朋友問我：「你這檔套這麼深，怎麼還能睡得著？」
我說：「因為我已經把它從『投資』改名成『傳家寶』了。」
短期是虧損，長期是資產配置，超長期就是留給孫子的驚喜。
只要活得夠久，任何套牢都只是還沒到期的定存。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個把停損拖成存股、用時間換取心安的深套戶
variations: 我不是被套牢，我只是選擇了一個很長的持有週期，長到需要立遺囑。
這檔不是虧損，是我留給下一代的教育基金，教他們不要學我。

en.content:
A friend asked me, "You're down this much on that stock, how do you even sleep?"
I said, "Easy — I renamed it from 'investment' to 'family heirloom.'"
Short term it's a loss, long term it's asset allocation, and super-long term it's a surprise for my grandkids.
Live long enough and any bag you're holding is just a fixed deposit that hasn't matured yet.
en.editorNote: For the deeply underwater holder who converted a stop-loss into a buy-and-hold and buys peace of mind with time
variations: I'm not stuck in a losing position, I just chose a very long holding period — long enough to require a will.
It's not a loss, it's an education fund for the next generation: a lesson in not doing what I did.

items.sourceNote: 「portfolio needs therapy / trust issues」register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
我的投資組合需要看心理諮商。
我也是。
它每天崩潰一次，我陪它一起崩潰，這叫共患難。
諮商師問我最近壓力來源，我打開對帳單給他看，他沉默了三秒，說：「這個我沒辦法，你要看的是財經頻道，不是我。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個帳戶跟心情一起需要急救的同好，貼在群組互相取暖
variations: 我跟我的股票有一個共識：它崩盤，我崩潰，公平。
別人靠冥想放鬆，我靠不打開券商 APP。

en.content:
My portfolio needs therapy.
So do I.
It melts down once a day, I melt down right along with it — we call that solidarity.
My therapist asked about my main source of stress. I opened my brokerage app and showed her. She went quiet for three seconds and said, 'This one's above my pay grade — you need a finance channel, not me.'
en.editorNote: For everyone whose account and mood both need emergency care. Share in the chat for mutual comfort
variations: My stock and I have an understanding: it crashes, I cry. Fair's fair.
Other people relax by meditating. I relax by not opening the brokerage app.

items.sourceNote: 「refreshing apps / pretending portfolio doesn't control your emotions」register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
現在的投資，說穿了就是一直下拉刷新，然後假裝那個數字不會影響我的心情。
綠了，我告訴自己：長期投資看什麼一時。
又綠了，我下拉刷新，看它有沒有改主意。
它沒有。
但我還是每三分鐘問它一次，像個不肯放手的前任。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在盤中忍不住第一百次下拉刷新時，對自己苦笑一下再發
variations: 我一天下拉刷新的次數，比我一年運動的次數還多。
股票不會因為你多看它幾眼就漲，但我還是看了。

en.content:
Investing these days is basically pulling to refresh and pretending that number doesn't run my mood.
Red, and I tell myself: long-term investor, who cares about one day.
Still red, so I pull to refresh again to see if it changed its mind.
It didn't.
I still ask it every three minutes anyway, like an ex who won't let go.
en.editorNote: For the intraday moment you pull-to-refresh for the hundredth time — smile at yourself, then post
variations: I pull to refresh more times in a day than I exercise in a year.
A stock doesn't go up because you stare at it. I stared anyway.

items.sourceNote: 「buy high cry later」register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
投資大師的口訣是：買低賣高。
我的口訣是：買高、哭晚一點。
我不是不知道要買在低點，我只是每次都要等它漲到最高、確認它真的很棒之後，才敢放心進場。
畢竟買一個沒人要的便宜貨，多沒面子。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個把「買低賣高」實踐成「買高賣更低」的追高仔
variations: 我的交易策略很前衛：先追高，再套牢，最後認賠，一氣呵成。
便宜的時候我看不上，貴的時候我看不開。

en.content:
The gurus' motto is: buy low, sell high.
My motto is: buy high, cry later.
It's not that I don't know to buy the bottom — I just need it to rip to the top and prove it's really great before I dare to buy in.
Buying some cheap thing nobody wants? Where's the dignity in that?
en.editorNote: For the chaser who turned 'buy low, sell high' into 'buy high, sell lower'
variations: My trading strategy is avant-garde: chase the top, get stuck, capitulate — all in one smooth motion.
When it's cheap I look down on it. When it's expensive I can't get over it.

items.sourceNote: 「roller coaster, scream after it drops」register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
有人說股市像雲霄飛車，刺激又好玩。
我覺得不太一樣。
雲霄飛車是往下俯衝的時候尖叫，我的股票是俯衝完、確認回不去了，我才開始尖叫。
而且雲霄飛車坐完會停，我這台，還在往下。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在盤中一路綠到心臟受不了時，配一杯冰的默默轉發
variations: 別人的雲霄飛車有安全帶，我的沒有，還是自己排隊去坐的。
股市的刺激感是真的，只是門票是用我的本金付的。

en.content:
People say the market is like a roller coaster — thrilling and fun.
I'd say it's a little different.
On a roller coaster you scream during the drop. With my stock, I only start screaming after the drop, once I've confirmed there's no coming back.
And a roller coaster eventually stops. Mine is still going down.
en.editorNote: For the intraday all-green stretch that your heart can't handle — post it quietly with a cold drink
variations: Other people's roller coasters have safety bars. Mine doesn't, and I lined up for it myself.
The thrill of the market is real. I just paid for the ticket with my principal.

items.sourceNote: Dcard 股板「不存股存梗圖」迷因股神 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
有人存股，有人存 ETF，我存梗圖。
三年下來，我的股票市值歸零，但我的梗圖資料夾已經破千張，張張都是用真金白銀換來的血淚。
別人靠投資財務自由，我靠投資，收藏了一整個資料夾的自己。
這大概是我唯一沒賠的投資：買到教訓，附贈素材。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個帳戶見底、梗圖爆棚的股板同學，貼在群組配圖服用
variations: 我在股市唯一穩定的產出，是可以做成梗圖的失敗經驗。
本金越來越少，笑話越來越多，這叫做另類的複利。

en.content:
Some people stack stocks, some stack ETFs. I stack memes.
Three years in, my portfolio is worth zero, but my meme folder has cracked a thousand images — every one paid for in real cash and real tears.
Other people invest their way to financial freedom. I invested my way to a folder full of myself.
It's probably my only investment that never lost money: I bought lessons, and the material came free.
en.editorNote: For the forum regular whose account bottomed out while the meme folder overflows. Serve in the chat with a picture attached
variations: My only consistent output in the market is failure that makes for good memes.
Less principal, more punchlines. Call it an alternative form of compounding.

items.sourceNote: 2026 台股融資餘額破 3700 億 / 散戶槓桿爆增 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
新聞說，融資餘額又創新高了，代表散戶信心很足。
我看了一下，那筆錢裡面有我借來的。
本來我只想小賭一把，後來想說既然要賺，就用槓桿放大。
現在放大的不是獲利，是我每天早上打開對帳單的心跳。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在看到融資爆增新聞、自己也重壓槓桿的盤中默默轉發
variations: 融資是一種很公平的工具：它把你的貪心跟恐懼，同時放大兩倍。
我用槓桿買進的那一刻，就把自己的睡眠一起質押出去了。

en.content:
The news says margin balances hit a new high again — proof retail confidence is strong.
I checked, and some of that borrowed money is mine.
I only meant to make a small bet, then figured if I'm going to win, I might as well use leverage to amplify it.
What got amplified wasn't the profit. It was my heart rate every morning I open the statement.
en.editorNote: For the intraday moment you see the 'margin debt surging' headline and realize you're one of the numbers
variations: Leverage is a fair tool: it doubles your greed and your fear at exactly the same time.
The second I bought on margin, I pledged my sleep as collateral too.

items.sourceNote: 三大法人賣超、散戶接盤 / 「想賺又害怕」register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
新聞標題：「台股頻創新高，法人連日賣超。」
我心想：法人在賣，那是誰在買？
打開對帳單的那一刻，我找到了答案。
原來這場派對，主人早就走了，只剩我一個人在收桌子，還以為自己是被邀請的貴賓。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個看到法人連日賣超、自己卻越買越多的同好，貼在群組互相提醒
variations: 指數創新高的時候，法人在門口跟我揮手道別，我還以為他在跟我打招呼。
所謂籌碼從法人手上流到散戶手上，那個散戶最近都叫我的名字。

en.content:
Headline: 'Market keeps hitting new highs, institutions net sellers for days.'
I thought: if the institutions are selling, who's buying?
The moment I opened my statement, I found the answer.
Turns out the host left this party long ago, and I'm the only one still clearing the table — convinced I was the guest of honor.
en.editorNote: For everyone watching institutions dump for days while they keep buying more. Share in the chat as a mutual reminder
variations: As the index made new highs, the institutions waved goodbye at the door. I thought they were saying hi.
They say the chips flow from institutions to retail. Lately that retail investor answers to my name.

items.sourceNote: 費半單日暴跌逾一成 / 「大跌是布局機會」反諷 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
費半那天暴跌一成，分析師說：「這是難得的布局機會。」
我信了，於是我進場布局。
隔天又跌，分析師說：「更好的布局機會來了。」
我又布局。
布局到最後我才發現，我布的不是局，是我自己的墳，一鏟一鏟，挖得很認真。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在被『大跌是機會』連續推坑、越接越低的下殺盤中服用
variations: 『難得的布局機會』的難得之處，在於它每天都出現一次。
分析師說的布局機會，最後布成了我一個人的長期居住地。

en.content:
The semiconductor index cratered over ten percent in a day, and the analyst said: 'A rare opportunity to build a position.'
I believed him, so I built.
Next day it fell again. The analyst said: 'An even better opportunity to build.'
So I built again.
Eventually I realized I wasn't building a position — I was digging my own grave, one careful shovel at a time.
en.editorNote: Take during a waterfall selloff when you keep catching lower on 'the dip is an opportunity'
variations: The rare thing about a 'rare buying opportunity' is that it shows up once a day.
The analyst's buying opportunity slowly turned into my permanent long-term residence.

items.sourceNote: 市場過熱後冷卻期 / 降息信仰動搖 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
我這半年最堅定的信仰，是降息。
我睡前禱告降息，起床祈禱降息，重壓的每一分錢都押在降息上。
結果央行說：「再看看。」
我的信仰跟我的本金一起動搖了，這才明白，原來我不是在投資，我是在等一個永遠不確定會不會來的神蹟。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個把整個部位都壓在利率決策上、開會前睡不著的同好
variations: 我對降息的信仰，比我對自己選股的信心還強，可惜兩個最後都落空。
市場過熱要冷卻，我的帳戶已經先冷卻給大家看了。

en.content:
My most devout belief this half of the year was a rate cut.
I prayed for a cut before bed, prayed for a cut when I woke, and bet every last dollar of my oversized position on it.
Then the central bank said: 'We'll see.'
My faith wavered along with my principal, and that's when I understood — I wasn't investing, I was waiting for a miracle that may never come.
en.editorNote: For everyone with their whole book riding on a rate decision, sleepless the night before the meeting
variations: My faith in a rate cut was stronger than my faith in my own stock picks. Both ended up unanswered.
They say an overheated market needs to cool down. My account already cooled off ahead of everyone else.

items.sourceNote: 7/2 盤後閒聊 台股46744 微台一天賠1萬 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
有人跟我說，玩期貨要控制風險、小口操作，不要一次壓太大。
我聽話，只買了一口微型的。
結果我發現，微型的意思是合約很小，賠起來卻一點都不微型。
一天賠一萬，這輩子我第一次覺得『微』這個字，很有份量。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個以為玩小口就能睡好覺、結果一天照樣賠一萬的期貨新手
variations: 微台的『微』是形容合約，不是形容我的損失。
我很有紀律地控制口數，然後很沒紀律地讓每一口都賠好賠滿。

en.content:
Someone told me: with futures, manage your risk, trade small, never bet too big at once.
I listened, and only bought one micro contract.
Then I learned what 'micro' actually means — the contract is small, but the losses are not micro at all.
Down ten grand in a day. First time in my life the word 'tiny' carried so much weight.
en.editorNote: For the futures rookie who thought trading small meant sleeping soundly, then dropped ten grand in a day anyway
variations: The 'micro' in micro futures describes the contract, not my loss.
I disciplined myself on position size, then very undisciplinedly maxed out the loss on every single one.

items.sourceNote: 「Gains are shy, losses are loud」register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
我發現獲利跟虧損的個性完全不一樣。
賺錢的時候很安靜，賺一點點就縮回去，一句話都不敢多說。
賠錢的時候很大聲，一路往下狂喊，深怕全世界不知道我在賠。
我的帳戶就是這樣：內向的是獲利，外向的是虧損。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在小賺就跑、大賠死抱的矛盾時刻，自嘲一下發群組
variations: 我的獲利很害羞，露臉一下就跑；我的虧損很自來熟，賴著不走。
賺的時候手很快，賠的時候手很僵，這大概就是散戶的宿命。

en.content:
I've noticed gains and losses have totally opposite personalities.
Gains are shy — they show up briefly, shrink back the moment I'm barely green, and never say a word too much.
Losses are loud — they scream all the way down, terrified the whole world might not know I'm bleeding.
That's my account in a nutshell: the introvert is my profit, the extrovert is my loss.
en.editorNote: For the contradiction of snatching tiny gains and death-gripping big losses — share in the chat with a wince
variations: My gains are shy and bolt after a quick hello. My losses are the friend who never leaves.
My hands are fast when it's green and frozen when it's red. That's the retail curse.

items.sourceNote: 「buy low, sold lower」register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
老師教的是低買高賣。
我改良了一下，發明了一套自己的：低買，更低賣。
進場的時候我很有信心，覺得這就是最低點了。
出場的時候我更有信心，因為我證明了剛剛那個絕對不是最低點。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個把『低買高賣』實踐成『低買更低賣』的同好，貼在群組互相取暖
variations: 我唯一穩定的能力，是把每一個低點都買成半山腰。
別人是買低賣高，我是買低、抱著、然後在更低的地方含淚說再見。

en.content:
The textbook says buy low, sell high.
I improved on it and invented my own version: buy low, sell lower.
Going in, I'm full of confidence that this is the bottom.
Going out, I'm even more confident — because I've now proven that first price definitely wasn't the bottom.
en.editorNote: For everyone who turned 'buy low, sell high' into 'buy low, sell lower' — share in the group for mutual comfort
variations: My one consistent skill is buying every bottom and turning it into a midway ledge.
Others buy low and sell high. I buy low, hold on, then say a tearful goodbye somewhere even lower.

items.sourceNote: 「Red days hit different」register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
在台股，紅的是漲，綠的是跌，這我知道。
但奇怪的是，我看盤的心情，跟顏色沒什麼關係，只跟我有沒有買有關係。
我有買的那檔，永遠是綠的。
我沒買的那檔，永遠是紅的。
原來決定漲跌的不是市場，是我的持股。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在盤中看著自己的持股一片綠、沒買的一片紅時，苦笑分享
variations: 我沒買的股票都在替我示範什麼叫做漲停。
我的持股顏色很單純，長期維持一種穩定的綠。

en.content:
In this market I know green means up and red means down.
Weird thing is, my mood while watching the screen has nothing to do with the color — only with whether I own it.
The ones I bought are always red.
The ones I skipped are always green.
Turns out it's not the market that decides which way things go. It's my holdings.
en.editorNote: For staring intraday at your own bag bleeding while everything you passed on rips — share with a bitter laugh
variations: Every stock I didn't buy is out there demonstrating what a limit-up looks like.
My portfolio's color scheme is simple — a steady, long-term shade of red.

items.sourceNote: 7/6 盤後閒聊 台股46556 回檔 / 「總會反彈的吧」register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
每次股價跌下來，我都會跟自己說一句：『總會反彈的吧。』
這句話我已經講了半年。
它反彈過幾次，每次都很有誠意地反彈一點點，然後繼續往下。
我終於明白，『總會反彈的吧』不是分析，是一種宗教，而我是最虔誠的信徒。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個靠一句『總會反彈的吧』撐著不停損的同好，貼在群組互相催眠
variations: 『總會反彈的吧』這句咒語，我唸了半年，股價完全沒在聽。
反彈是有的，只是每次都反彈到讓我剛好不甘心賣，然後再創新低。

en.content:
Every time the price drops, I tell myself one line: 'It'll bounce back eventually, right?'
I've been saying it for half a year.
It has bounced a few times — always a sincere little bounce, then straight back down.
I finally understand: 'it'll bounce eventually' isn't analysis, it's a religion, and I'm the most devout believer.
en.editorNote: For everyone holding off on a stop-loss with the mantra 'it'll bounce' — share in the chat for mutual hypnosis
variations: I've chanted 'it'll bounce eventually' for six months. The price has not been listening.
It does bounce — just enough each time that I can't bring myself to sell, right before the next new low.

items.sourceNote: 融資斷頭 / 槓桿放大虧損 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
我以為融資是讓我用小錢賺大錢的槓桿。
後來才知道，槓桿有兩頭，主力坐短的那頭，我坐長的那頭。
股價跌了三天，券商打電話來，語氣很客氣：「先生，要不要補一點錢？不然我幫您賣。」
這是我這輩子聽過最委婉的通知——原來『斷頭』兩個字，可以講得這麼溫柔。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個用融資放大夢想、結果被放大虧損的槓桿勇者
variations: 融資的槓桿，放大的從來不是我的獲利，是我的心跳。
券商幫我『處理』持股的效率，比我自己下單還快。

en.content:
I thought margin was the lever that turns small money into big money.
Later I learned a lever has two ends — the whales sit on the short end, I sit on the long one.
The stock dropped for three days, my broker called, very politely: 'Sir, would you like to add a little cash? Otherwise I'll sell it for you.'
It's the gentlest notice I've ever received — turns out 'margin call' can be phrased so tenderly.
en.editorNote: For every leverage warrior who used margin to amplify the dream and amplified the loss instead
variations: The lever of margin never amplified my gains, only my heart rate.
My broker liquidates my positions faster than I can place an order.

items.sourceNote: 2026 問 AI 選股 / AI 明牌 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
2026 年了，我不再相信理專，也不再相信親戚，我開始相信 AI。
我問 AI：「幫我選一檔會漲的股票。」它給了我三檔，理由充分到我熱淚盈眶。
我全買了，結果三檔一起跌。
我回去問它為什麼，它很誠實：「我只負責分析，不負責結果。」
原來 AI 跟理專最大的共通點，是賠錢的都是我。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個 2026 年開始問 AI 明牌、結果 AI 也套你的科技追隨者
variations: 我問 AI 該買什麼，它答得很好，可惜市場沒在看它的答案。
AI 取代了理專，唯一沒被取代的環節，是最後買單的那個人。

en.content:
It's 2026. I no longer trust advisors, I no longer trust relatives — I started trusting AI.
I asked it: 'Pick me a stock that'll go up.' It gave me three, laid out with such airtight logic I nearly teared up.
I bought all three. All three dropped.
I went back and asked why, and it answered honestly: 'I only handle the analysis, not the outcome.'
Turns out AI and financial advisors have one thing in common — the one who loses money is always me.
en.editorNote: For the 2026 tech follower who started asking AI for hot tips and got bagged by the algorithm too
variations: I asked AI what to buy. Great answer. Shame the market wasn't reading it.
AI replaced the advisor. The one link it couldn't replace was the guy who pays for it all in the end.

items.sourceNote: 反指標認證 / 朋友跟你反著做 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
我朋友最近建了一個群組，觀察對象只有我一個，其他人專門看我要買什麼。
我買，他們就賣；我賣，他們就買。
上個月他們靠著跟我反著做，人人賺錢，還揪團請我吃飯。
我坐在那頓飯桌上，一邊被感謝，一邊默默算自己這個月的虧損，突然覺得自己好像是某種公共財。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個被朋友當成穩定反指標、還要負責被感謝的靈魂人物
variations: 我不是不會賺錢，我是把賺錢的權利外包給了所有跟我反著做的人。
全世界都在等我出手，因為那是最可靠的訊號——反著做就對了。

en.content:
My friend recently started a group chat with exactly one subject under observation: me. Everyone else just watches what I'm about to buy.
I buy, they sell. I sell, they buy.
Last month they all made money fading me, and threw a dinner to thank me.
I sat at that table, being thanked on one side while tallying my own monthly losses on the other, and suddenly felt like some kind of public utility.
en.editorNote: For the soul who's become their friends' most reliable contrarian indicator — and still gets thanked for it
variations: It's not that I can't make money. I just outsourced the right to make it to everyone who fades me.
The whole world waits for me to make a move, because it's the most reliable signal there is: do the opposite.

items.sourceNote: 定期定額存股 / 時間複利反諷 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
理財書說：定期定額，長期下來平均成本會很漂亮，時間會幫你賺錢。
於是我每個月固定扣款，風雨無阻，扣了整整兩年。
時間確實幫我做了一件事——它很有耐心地，每個月固定，把我的錢定期定額地搬走。
現在我終於懂了，定期定額最穩定的部分，是那個『定期』，跟那個『額』。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個相信時間複利、結果先體驗到時間的存股族
variations: 我很有紀律地定期定額，市場也很有紀律地定期定額回收。
定期定額買進的是股票，累積出來的是回憶。

en.content:
The finance book said: dollar-cost average, and over time your average cost gets beautiful — time will make money for you.
So I set an auto-buy every month, rain or shine, for two full years.
Time did do one thing for me — very patiently, on the same date every month, it dollar-cost-averaged my money right out of my account.
Now I finally get it: the most reliable part of dollar-cost averaging is the 'cost.'
en.editorNote: For the dividend-stacker who believed in the magic of compounding time and experienced the time part first
variations: I dollar-cost average with great discipline. The market recoups it with equal discipline.
What I bought was shares. What accumulated was memories.

items.sourceNote: 回本執念 / 回本又捨不得賣 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
我對那檔套牢的股票只有一個卑微的願望：只要讓我回本，我立刻就走，從此互不相欠。
結果它真的漲了，慢慢爬回我的成本價。
回本的那一刻，我看著螢幕，心裡冒出一句話：「都撐這麼久了，再等一下會不會賺更多？」
於是我沒賣。然後它又跌回去了。
原來我不是想回本，我是想貪心，只是穿了回本的外衣。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個發誓『回本就走』、結果回本又捨不得走的貪心鬼
variations: 回本前我求解套，回本後我要獲利，人心就是這樣一路把自己套回去的。
我等的不是回本，是一個永遠說服不了自己賣出的藉口。

en.content:
I had one humble wish for that underwater stock: just let me break even and I'll walk away, no hard feelings, we're square.
Then it actually climbed, slowly crawling back to my cost.
The moment it hit break-even, I stared at the screen and a thought bubbled up: 'I've held this long — wouldn't a little longer mean a little more?'
So I didn't sell. Then it dropped right back down.
Turns out I never wanted to break even. I wanted to be greedy, just dressed up as breaking even.
en.editorNote: For the greedy soul who swore 'I'll sell at break-even' and couldn't let go once it got there
variations: Before break-even I begged to get out. After, I demanded a profit. That's how you talk yourself right back underwater.
What I was waiting for wasn't break-even. It was an excuse I could never quite talk myself out of.

items.sourceNote: 「當沖勒戒所」社群 / 賠錢文比賺錢文受歡迎 / 提供情緒價值 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
在我加的那個股票社團，賺錢文沒人理，賠錢文才是流量密碼。
我貼出賺三千的截圖，底下零留言。
我貼出賠三十萬的對帳單，瞬間破百讚，還有人留言：「大大這種等級的虧損，一般人玩不出來，佩服。」
原來在這裡，能賠得驚天動地的，才是真正的高手。我終於靠虧損，紅了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個把賠錢對帳單當內容分享、在社團互相取暖的同好
variations: 在這個圈子，你賺多少沒人記得，但你賠得夠慘，大家會永遠記得你。
我沒賺到錢，但我賺到了整個社團的情緒價值，這算不算另類獲利。

en.content:
In the stock group I joined, winning posts get ignored — losing posts are the real traffic magnet.
I posted a screenshot of a $100 gain: zero comments.
I posted a statement showing a $10k loss: instant hundred likes, plus a comment: 'Boss, a loss at this level takes real skill, ordinary people can't pull it off. Respect.'
Turns out around here, whoever can lose spectacularly is the true master. I finally went viral — off my losses.
en.editorNote: For everyone who shares their red statement as content and finds comfort in the group chat
variations: In this crowd, nobody remembers how much you made, but if you lose badly enough, they'll remember you forever.
I didn't make any money, but I generated emotional value for the whole group. Does that count as an alternative return?

items.sourceNote: 新手運 / 第一筆賺錢誤以為是實力、重壓後畢業 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
我剛開戶第一筆就賺錢，那一刻我以為自己是天生的操盤手，市場的鬼才。
於是我把整副身家壓下去，準備一戰成名。
結果市場很快就教我認清：原來那不是實力，是新手運，一種市場專門用來釣魚的餌。
我第一筆賺的錢，只是頭期款，剩下的分期，我後來全部還清了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個靠新手運嘗到甜頭、加碼重壓後被市場好好上了一課的同好
variations: 新手運是市場給你的試用期優惠，等你上癮了，就開始跟你收原價。
我第一次賺錢以為是實力，第二次賠錢才知道那是誘餌，第三次我還是又進場了。

en.content:
My very first trade after opening the account made money, and in that moment I was convinced I was a born trader, a market prodigy.
So I threw my whole net worth in, ready to make my name in one shot.
The market quickly set me straight: that wasn't skill, it was beginner's luck — bait the market keeps on the hook.
The money from my first trade was just the down payment. The installments after that, I've since paid off in full.
en.editorNote: For everyone who tasted beginner's luck, went all in, and got thoroughly schooled by the market
variations: Beginner's luck is the market's free trial. Once you're hooked, it starts charging full price.
My first win, I thought was skill. My second loss, I learned was bait. My third time, I entered anyway.

items.sourceNote: 2026 上半年 / 年中半年報結算 / 年初立志今年一定賺 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
年初我立下一個宏大的目標：2026 年，一定要靠投資賺回一台車。
現在七月了，我打開半年結算：不但沒賺到車，連原本的頭期款都開走了。
我年初許的願，市場很認真地實現了——只是它把「賺一台車」聽成「賠一台車」。
下半年目標下修：只要別再賠一台車，就算大獲全勝。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個年初雄心壯志、年中打開對帳單默默把目標砍半的同好
variations: 上半年我的投資報酬率是負的，唯一成長的是我對市場的敬畏。
年初的計畫是財務自由，年中的計畫是財務止血，年底的計畫大概是財務投降。

en.content:
At the start of the year I set a grand goal: in 2026, I'll make enough from investing to buy a car.
Now it's July, and I open my half-year tally: not only no car, even the original down payment drove off.
The market took my New Year's wish very seriously and granted it — it just heard 'make a car' as 'lose a car.'
Revised second-half goal: as long as I don't lose another car, I'll call it a total victory.
en.editorNote: For everyone who started the year full of ambition and quietly halved the goal at the mid-year statement
variations: My return for the first half of the year was negative. The only thing that grew was my respect for the market.
New Year plan: financial freedom. Mid-year plan: financial damage control. Year-end plan: probably financial surrender.

items.sourceNote: 「散戶最會處理感情，習慣了突然的下跌與意外的上漲」關係雙關 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
朋友問我，為什麼你感情這麼穩，什麼大風大浪都不怕？
我說，因為我玩股票。
突然的下跌、意外的上漲、莫名其妙的橫盤、講好要漲卻背刺的走勢，我全部都經歷過了。
經過市場的洗禮，另一半偶爾的情緒波動，對我來說根本是風平浪靜。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合貼在交往紀念日或被問到抗壓性時，順便自嘲一下投資人生
variations: 談戀愛需要的所有能力——忍耐、等待、被背刺後還能微笑——股市早就幫我訓練好了。
我對另一半的耐心，都是被那些套牢的股票磨出來的。

en.content:
A friend asked me why my relationship is so steady, why nothing ever rattles me.
I said, because I trade stocks.
Sudden drops, unexpected rallies, endless sideways chop, trends that promised to go up and then stabbed me in the back — I've been through all of it.
After what the market puts me through, my partner's occasional mood swing feels like a flat calm.
en.editorNote: Good for a relationship anniversary or when someone asks how you handle stress — with a side of investor self-deprecation
variations: Every skill a relationship needs — patience, waiting, smiling after getting stabbed in the back — the market already trained into me.
All the patience I have for my partner was ground into me by the stocks I got stuck holding.

items.sourceNote: 台股 FOMO 狂潮 / 群組裡大家都在曬獲利、只有我是綠的 相對剝奪感 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
我們那個投資群組，每天都有人曬對帳單，紅通通一片，動不動就是今天又賺一個月薪水。
我默默把手機轉暗，因為我的對帳單，是全群組唯一一抹綠。
他們說隨便買都賺，我照著隨便買，結果只有我隨便賠。
後來我才想通：不是市場對我不好，是我剛好站在那群曬單人的對面，當他們的獲利來源。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個在群組被獲利截圖轟炸、只有自己虧損的同好，貼上去互相取暖
variations: 全群組都在慶功，只有我一個人在對帳單前面辦告別式。
看別人曬單最難受的地方，不是他賺，是他賺的那筆，感覺很像我賠的那筆。

en.content:
In our investing group chat, someone flexes their statement every day — a sea of green, casually up a month's salary before lunch.
I quietly dim my phone, because my statement is the only splash of red in the whole group.
They say you can buy anything and win. I bought anything, and I'm the only one who lost.
Eventually it clicked: the market isn't picking on me — I just happen to be standing on the opposite side of all those flexers, serving as their source of profit.
en.editorNote: For everyone bombarded by green screenshots in the group chat while sitting on a loss — post it for mutual comfort
variations: The whole group is throwing a victory party while I hold a memorial service in front of my statement.
The worst part of watching someone flex their gains isn't that they won. It's that their win looks a lot like my loss.

items.sourceNote: 台股半年暴漲1.9萬點、民調逾23%投資人反而慘賠 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
新聞說台股半年暴漲快兩萬點，然後補了一句：還是有超過兩成的人在這波裡慘賠。
我看完鬆了一口氣，原來我不孤單。
再看一眼對帳單，又緊張起來，因為那兩成裡面，排名最前面的好像是我。
全民瘋股的年代，我負責提供那個讓數據看起來比較真實的樣本。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個大盤狂飆卻剛好站在虧損那一格的同好，貼在群組報平安
variations: 統計上總要有人賠，我一直很有公德心地扛下這個名額。
全民都在賺的新聞，需要一個對照組，我自願報名。

en.content:
The news said the market ripped nearly 20,000 points in half a year, then added a footnote: over a fifth of investors still lost money.
I felt relieved for a second — turns out I'm not alone.
Then I glanced at my statement and tensed up again, because within that fifth, I seem to be ranked near the top.
In the age of everyone chasing stocks, I'm the sample that makes the data look believable.
en.editorNote: For everyone who somehow landed in the loss column while the index went vertical — post it in the chat to check in
variations: Statistically someone has to lose. I've civic-mindedly volunteered for the slot every time.
Every 'everyone's getting rich' headline needs a control group. I signed up.

items.sourceNote: 融資餘額推升至17年新高 / 借錢追高槓桿 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
怕自己的錢賠得不夠快，於是我開了融資，借券商的錢一起下場。
這招真的有效，現在我賠錢的速度，正式追上我看盤的速度。
新聞說融資餘額創十七年新高，我看了很有參與感——那個高，有我墊的一塊。
原來槓桿的意思是，賺的時候你沒跟上，賠的時候它幫你加倍奉還。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個手滑開了融資、以為能翻身結果翻車的同學，開槓桿前先看一眼
variations: 融資讓我體驗到一種全新的心跳：借來的錢在賠，也是很痛的。
我用槓桿放大了獲利的想像，跟虧損的實際。

en.content:
Worried my own money wasn't bleeding fast enough, I opened a margin account and borrowed the broker's money to join in.
It really worked — now my speed of losing money has officially caught up to my speed of watching the screen.
The news says margin balances hit a 17-year high. I felt strangely involved — there's a brick of mine holding that high up.
Turns out leverage means: when it goes up, you miss it, and when it goes down, it pays you back double.
en.editorNote: For everyone who impulsively turned on margin expecting a comeback and got a crash — read this before leveraging up
variations: Margin gave me a brand-new kind of heartbeat: watching borrowed money lose money hurts too.
I used leverage to magnify my imagined gains, and my actual losses.

items.sourceNote: 他3萬9全賣傻眼「到底在漲什麼」/ 賣飛踏空 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
我在三萬九那天覺得夠高了，把手上的全部清光，跟市場瀟灑說再見。
然後它一路往四萬八去，我站在原地，手裡空空，嘴裡只剩一句：這到底在漲什麼？
我不是被套牢，我是被留在月台上，看著整班列車揚長而去。
原來清倉那一刻的踏實，是拿後面每一根長紅換來的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個提早下車、然後看它一路噴出的同好，貼在群組互相安慰
variations: 我沒賠錢，我只是把賺錢的機會提前退貨了。
空手看它漲，比套牢看它跌，是另一種等級的折磨。

en.content:
At 39,000 I decided it was high enough, dumped everything, and waved the market a stylish goodbye.
Then it marched all the way to 48,000 while I stood there empty-handed, with one question stuck in my throat: what is even pumping this?
I'm not underwater. I'm just left on the platform, watching the whole train pull away.
Turns out the peace of mind from selling out was paid for with every green candle that came after.
en.editorNote: For everyone who got off early and then watched it rip — share it in the chat for mutual consolation
variations: I didn't lose money. I just returned my chance to make some, ahead of schedule.
Watching it rise with empty hands is a different tier of torture than watching it fall while holding.

items.sourceNote: 「if regret were a stock I'd be the majority shareholder」register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
如果『後悔』是一檔股票，那我肯定是它的最大股東，而且天天加碼。
後悔太早賣、後悔太晚買、後悔沒停損、後悔停損太快。
我的投資組合裡，唯一長期穩定成長的資產，就是後悔。
別人分散風險，我分散後悔，種類多到可以自組一檔 ETF。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個復盤時比看盤還認真、把每一步都拿來後悔的同好
variations: 我最會操作的一檔，是後悔，越攤越多，從不停損。
如果後悔能配息，我早就財務自由了。

en.content:
If regret were a stock, I'd be its majority shareholder — and I add to the position daily.
Regret selling too early, regret buying too late, regret not cutting losses, regret cutting them too fast.
In my whole portfolio, the only asset with steady long-term growth is regret.
Other people diversify their risk. I diversify my regret — enough varieties to build my own ETF.
en.editorNote: For everyone who reviews their trades harder than they watch the market, turning every move into a fresh regret
variations: My best-performing holding is regret. I keep averaging in and never take the loss.
If regret paid dividends, I'd have retired years ago.

items.sourceNote: 「mindful investing / 面帶微笑看紅字」正念自嘲 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
理專最近教我一個新觀念，叫做『正念投資』——不要被短期波動綁架，保持平靜。
於是現在收盤後，我會面帶微笑，用一種很禪的表情，凝視滿螢幕的綠。
我的內心一片祥和，帳戶一片綠意，兩者相安無事。
原來所謂的正念，就是連虧損都虧得很有氣質。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個學了一堆心法、只為了心平氣和面對虧損的同好
variations: 我沒有變厲害，我只是變得很會用平靜的表情看自己賠錢。
正念投資的最高境界，是滿江綠的時候還能微笑點頭說：嗯，我看見了。

en.content:
My advisor taught me a new concept lately called 'mindful investing' — don't get hostage to short-term swings, stay calm.
So now, after the close, I smile softly and gaze at a screen full of red with a very zen expression.
My mind is at peace, my account is in the red, and the two coexist without conflict.
Turns out mindfulness just means losing money with excellent posture.
en.editorNote: For everyone who studied a dozen mindset frameworks purely to face their losses serenely
variations: I didn't get better at investing. I just got very good at watching myself lose with a peaceful face.
Peak mindful investing is nodding calmly at a screen of red and whispering: yes, I see you.

items.sourceNote: 散戶「想賺又害怕」+ 台股頻創新高、上攻五萬點 register；改寫原創 FOMO 糾結

zh-tw.content:
新聞說台股要上攻五萬點，同事一個一個都進場了。
我心裡有兩個聲音：一個喊『再不買就來不及了』，另一個喊『你上次也是這樣說的』。
最後我兩個都聽了——先追高買進，再連夜後悔。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個看著大盤噴出、手指懸在下單鍵上抖個不停的同好
variations: 最怕的不是賠錢，是別人都賺、只有我沒上車。
猶豫的時候大盤又漲一根，等我決定好，它已經在山頂等我了。

en.content:
They say the index is charging toward a new milestone, and my coworkers are piling in one by one.
Two voices argue in my head: one screams 'buy now or miss it forever,' the other says 'you said that last time too.'
So I listened to both — chased the top, then regretted it all night.
en.editorNote: For everyone watching the market rip higher with a finger trembling over the buy button
variations: My real fear isn't losing money. It's everyone winning while I'm the only one who missed the train.
Every time I hesitate, the chart prints another green candle. By the time I decide, it's waiting for me at the summit.

items.sourceNote: 融資餘額推升至 3700 億、17 年新高 register；改寫原創 槓桿取暖

zh-tw.content:
融資餘額創十七年新高，新聞用一種很擔心的語氣在報。
我看著自己的對帳單想：原來我不是一個人在戰鬥，全台灣的散戶都跟我一樣借錢梭哈。
我們不是韭菜，我們是有組織、有紀律、集體衝上山頂的韭菜。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合丟在開了融資的投資群組，讓大家在數字裡互相取暖
variations: 我的膽量是借來的，我的信心是槓桿撐起來的。
別人存錢是為了退休，我借錢是為了證明自己看得懂線。

en.content:
Margin balances just hit a 17-year high, and the news reports it in a very worried tone.
I look at my own statement and realize I'm not fighting alone — retail traders everywhere borrowed money to go all in, just like me.
We're not sheep to the slaughter. We're organized, disciplined sheep, charging up the mountain together.
en.editorNote: Drop this in the group chat full of leveraged friends so everyone can warm up around the numbers
variations: My courage is borrowed and my confidence is propped up by leverage.
Other people save for retirement. I borrow to prove I can read a chart.

items.sourceNote: 巴菲特指標過熱、多頭人人股神 register；改寫原創 退潮裸泳梗

zh-tw.content:
這波多頭漲下來，我發現自己突然變得很會投資。
買什麼漲什麼，隨便一支都賺，連我媽問我的明牌都中。
後來看到『巴菲特指標過熱』的新聞才想起來——
在牛市裡，每個人都是股神；退潮之後，才知道誰在裸泳。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個在大多頭裡開始覺得自己有天分的同好，先存起來，跌的時候再拿出來看
variations: 牛市最危險的地方，就是它會讓你以為賺錢是靠實力。
我一度以為自己是天才，直到大盤提醒我：只是風夠大而已。

en.content:
After this whole bull run, I've discovered I'm suddenly amazing at investing.
Everything I touch goes up, any random pick prints, even the tip I gave my mom hit.
Then I saw a headline about the 'overheated Buffett indicator' and remembered —
in a bull market everyone's a genius; only when the tide goes out do you find out who was swimming naked.
en.editorNote: For everyone who's started feeling gifted in a raging bull market — save it and reread it on the down days
variations: The most dangerous thing about a bull market is that it convinces you the money came from skill.
I thought I was a genius, until the market reminded me it was just the wind.

items.sourceNote: 違約交割金額創 7 年新高 register；改寫原創 信仰先違約梗

zh-tw.content:
新聞：『違約交割金額創七年新高。』
翻譯一下就是：有一群人下單的時候，帳戶裡的錢是想像出來的。
他們買的不是股票，是『我下禮拜一定湊得到錢』的信仰。
結果股票沒漲，信仰先違約了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合當作風險教育的黑色幽默，提醒身邊那個總說『先買再說』的朋友
variations: 買在信心最高、口袋最空的那一刻，是散戶的浪漫。
下單很爽，交割才是照妖鏡。

en.content:
Headline: 'Failed-settlement amounts hit a seven-year high.'
Translation: a bunch of people placed their orders with money that only existed in their imagination.
What they bought wasn't stock — it was faith that 'I'll definitely scrape the cash together by Monday.'
The stock didn't rally, but the faith defaulted first.
en.editorNote: Dark humor for a little risk education — send it to that friend who always says 'just buy first, figure it out later'
variations: Buying at the moment your confidence peaks and your wallet is emptiest — that's the romance of retail trading.
Placing the order feels great. Settlement day is the mirror that shows you who you really are.

items.sourceNote: 『FOMO as retirement plan / buy high cry later』英文投資 meme register；改寫原創 情緒配置梗

zh-tw.content:
我重新定義了我的理財規劃：
退休金——靠 FOMO。
風險控管——靠祈禱。
進場策略——買在最高，哭在最低。
朋友說這樣不行，我說沒關係，至少每一步我都很有參與感。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個把『這次不一樣』當成投資策略的同好，笑著笑著就想哭了
variations: 別人有資產配置，我有情緒配置：早上貪婪、晚上恐懼。
我的投資紀律只有一條：買高，然後慢慢學會後悔。

en.content:
I've redefined my financial plan:
Retirement fund — powered by FOMO.
Risk management — powered by prayer.
Entry strategy — buy at the top, cry at the bottom.
A friend says this won't work. I say that's fine — at least I feel deeply involved every step of the way.
en.editorNote: For everyone who treats 'this time is different' as an investment strategy — you laugh until you almost cry
variations: Other people have asset allocation. I have emotion allocation: greedy in the morning, terrified at night.
My only trading rule: buy high, then slowly learn to regret it.

items.sourceNote: 融資餘額 5,700 億創 26 年新高、散戶開槓桿追高 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
新聞：「台股融資餘額創二十六年新高，散戶瘋狂開槓桿。」
我看了看自己的融資部位，深呼吸，告訴自己：
這不是賭博，這是對台積電的深情告白，只是用了別人的錢。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合丟給那個一邊喊風險控管、一邊把信用額度用好用滿的股友
variations: 以前存錢才敢買股，現在借錢才夠追高，時代真的變了。
融資買的不是股票，是『我一定不會被斷頭』的自信。

en.content:
Headline: 'Margin balances hit a 26-year high as retail traders pile on leverage.'
I looked at my own margin position, took a deep breath, and told myself:
This isn't gambling. It's a heartfelt love letter to my favorite chip stock — just written with someone else's money.
en.editorNote: For the friend who preaches risk management while maxing out every last dollar of margin
variations: We used to save up before buying. Now we borrow just to keep chasing. Times really have changed.
Margin doesn't buy you stock. It buys you the confidence that you'll never get liquidated.

items.sourceNote: 全民開槓桿、股票質押/信貸/房貸增貸進場、結構性資金荒 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
朋友問我進場的錢從哪來。
我認真列了一下：一點融資、一點信貸、一點把股票拿去質押，還有一點是房貸增貸。
他嚇到說我這樣很危險。
我說沒事，我把資金來源分散得很好，這叫風險分散。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個把『多方借款』誤會成『資產配置』的同好，笑中帶淚
variations: 別人是拿閒錢投資，我是把每一種貸款都拿來投資。
我沒有富爸爸，但我有富銀行，還有富到願意借我的三家。

en.content:
A friend asked where my investing money comes from.
I listed it honestly: a bit of margin, a bit of a personal loan, a bit from pledging my shares, and a bit from topping up the mortgage.
He looked terrified and said that's dangerous.
I said relax — I've spread my funding across many sources. It's called diversification.
en.editorNote: For anyone who mistakes 'borrowing from everywhere' for 'asset allocation' — you laugh through the tears
variations: Some people invest with spare cash. I invest with every type of loan I could get approved for.
I don't have a rich dad, but I have a rich bank — and two more generous enough to lend.

items.sourceNote: diamond hands 死抱不賣 / welcome back to work 英文投資 meme register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
人家說我是鑽石手，套牢多深都不賣。
其實不是我意志堅定，是我一賣就變成真的虧損，不賣它就只是『暫時委屈』。
我不是在長期投資，我是在等它裝作沒事回來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合放在庫存深綠的截圖旁邊，給每個把『不賣就不算輸』當信仰的人
variations: 帳面上的虧損不是虧損，是我還沒按下確認鍵的秘密。
鑽石手的真相：不是捨不得賣，是捨不得面對。

en.content:
They call me diamond hands — no matter how deep the loss, I never sell.
Honestly, it's not willpower. The moment I sell, it becomes a real loss. As long as I hold, it's just 'temporarily inconvenienced.'
I'm not a long-term investor. I'm just waiting for it to come back and pretend nothing happened.
en.editorNote: Pair it with a screenshot of a deep-red portfolio, for everyone who treats 'not selling means not losing' as a religion
variations: An unrealized loss isn't a loss. It's a secret I just haven't clicked 'confirm' on yet.
The truth about diamond hands: it's not that I can't sell, it's that I can't face it.

items.sourceNote: 『你以為在交易，其實在幫券商打工』、散戶賠錢比例 90% register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
我算了一下今年的當沖成績：買賣次數三千多次，來回貢獻的手續費夠買一支新手機。
股票有沒有賺我不確定，但我很確定券商今年過得不錯。
原來我不是在投資，我是在上班，只是這份工作是我付錢給公司。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個把當沖當工作、卻忘了自己是倒貼那方的同好
variations: 全市場最穩的獲利模式，是每一筆都收手續費的那個。
我沒有老闆，但我每天準時上工，還自願加班貼錢。

en.content:
I tallied up my day-trading year: over three thousand round trips, enough fees paid to buy a brand-new phone.
I'm not sure whether I made money on the stocks, but I'm very sure my broker had a great year.
Turns out I wasn't investing. I was working a job — one where I pay the company.
en.editorNote: For everyone who treats day-trading as a job, forgetting they're the one footing the bill
variations: The most reliable business model in the whole market is the one collecting a fee on every single trade.
I have no boss, yet I clock in every day and volunteer for unpaid overtime.

items.sourceNote: 外媒直擊台股 FOMO、新手『隨便買都賺』、青少年搶開戶 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
去年剛開戶的表弟跟我說：「哥，現在隨便買都賺，你怎麼還在研究財報？」
我笑了笑，沒回話。
不是我不想賺快錢，是我上一次相信『隨便買都賺』的時候，市場給我上了一堂很貴的課。
新手最大的優勢，就是還沒被套牢過。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個第一次進場就覺得自己是股神的親戚，語氣要溫柔
variations: 『這次不一樣』這句話，通常是帳單開始變厚的前一秒。
牛市裡人人都是天才，熊市才知道誰在裸泳。

en.content:
My cousin, who opened his brokerage account last year, said to me: 'Bro, you can buy anything right now and win — why are you still reading financial statements?'
I just smiled and said nothing.
It's not that I don't want easy money. It's that the last time I believed 'you can buy anything and win,' the market taught me a very expensive lesson.
A beginner's biggest advantage is simply never having been trapped in a losing position yet.
en.editorNote: Send it to the relative who feels like a market genius on their very first trade — keep the tone gentle
variations: 'This time is different' is usually the sentence right before the bill starts getting thicker.
In a bull market everyone's a genius. It's the bear market that shows who was swimming naked.

items.sourceNote: 台積電法說成市場風向球、散戶等法說再決定進場 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
法說會前一天：「我要冷靜，等法說出來再決定要不要進場。」
法說會當天開盤：「跳空漲停了，我先追再說。」
收盤：「原來昨天的冷靜，是為了今天的追高。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個嘴巴說要等消息、手卻已經先送出委託單的同好
variations: 所有的『我再觀察一下』，都是『我等一下就會忍不住』的前奏。
法說會的功能，就是把我上禮拜的紀律，一次全部沒收。

en.content:
Day before the earnings call: 'Stay calm. I'll wait for the numbers before I decide anything.'
Market open on the day: 'It gapped up to the limit — I'm chasing first, thinking later.'
At the close: 'So yesterday's discipline was just prep work for today's FOMO.'
en.editorNote: For the friend whose mouth says 'wait for the news' while their hands already hit the buy button
variations: Every 'let me watch it a little longer' is the opening act for 'I won't be able to resist in a second.'
An earnings call exists to confiscate an entire week of my discipline in one morning.

items.sourceNote: 台股攻5萬點後進入休息格局、大盤創高但個股冷清 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
大盤快要五萬點了，親戚在家族群組發香檳貼圖。
我打開對帳單，數字停在我三年前買進的那一天，一動也不動。
指數在爬山，我的持股在冬眠——同一個市場，兩個世界。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在家族群組別人狂喜時，默默貼在自己限動，配一張沒有變化的庫存截圖
variations: 大盤創新高的意思是，別人的股票創新高。
我的股票很念舊，一直守著它剛認識我時的價位。

en.content:
The index is closing in on fifty thousand, and my relatives are dropping champagne emojis in the family chat.
I open my statement — the number is frozen on the exact day I bought in three years ago, refusing to move.
The index is climbing a mountain; my holdings are hibernating. Same market, two worlds.
en.editorNote: Post this quietly to your story while the family group chat celebrates, paired with a screenshot that never changes
variations: A record high on the index means someone else's stocks hit a record high.
My stock is deeply sentimental — it's still guarding the price it was at the day we first met.

items.sourceNote: 資金輪動、從高基期權值股轉向中小型題材股、散戶追題材 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
上個月我把記憶體換成散熱，這個月又把散熱換成機器人。
每一次都是看到別人先漲，我才追進去。
三個月下來我發現一個規律：我買進的那一族群，就是輪動結束的訊號。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給每個總是在輪動最後一棒接刀、還以為自己抓到主流的同好
variations: 我是全市場最靈敏的反指標，主力只要看我買什麼，就知道該出貨了。
所謂資金輪動，就是資金輪流離開我剛買進的每一檔。

en.content:
Last month I swapped memory chips for cooling stocks. This month I swapped cooling for robotics.
Every single time, I only chased in after watching someone else rally first.
Three months in, I've spotted a pattern: whichever sector I buy into is the signal that its rotation just ended.
en.editorNote: For everyone who always grabs the last leg of a rotation while believing they caught the main trend
variations: I'm the most sensitive contrarian indicator on the market — the whales just watch what I buy to know when to sell.
'Sector rotation' is just capital taking turns leaving every stock I've just bought.

items.sourceNote: 大盤單週跌3%、留長下影線、散戶承接力道強『信心強勁』 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
分析師說：「今天留了長下影線，代表下檔承接力道很強、散戶信心很強勁。」
我看著自己剛剛在低點勇敢加碼的委託單，默默把手機蓋起來。
原來新聞說的『強勁承接力道』，指的就是我。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在自己勇敢抄底、隔天繼續跌的時候，用來自我療癒兼自嘲
variations: 所謂散戶信心，就是每次接刀都相信這次是最後一刀。
長下影線是集體智慧的結晶，也是我一個人加碼的成本線。

en.content:
The analyst said: 'Today left a long lower shadow — strong support underneath, retail confidence is robust.'
I looked at the buy order I'd just bravely averaged down at the low, and quietly flipped my phone face-down.
Turns out the 'robust support' in the news was referring to me.
en.editorNote: Perfect self-therapy and self-mockery for the day after you bravely bought the dip and it kept dropping
variations: 'Retail confidence' is just believing, every time you catch the falling knife, that this is the last one.
A long lower shadow is the crystallization of collective wisdom — and also the average cost of me buying alone.

items.sourceNote: 散戶『害怕錯過行情』FOMO 追高、融資餘額從3,859億暴增到6,110億、台股狂瀉1,700點遭反噬 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
我不是怕虧錢，我是怕大家都賺、只有我沒賺。
於是我在最高點勇敢開了融資，把『錯過的恐懼』換成了『真實的虧損』。
現在我不怕錯過行情了——因為行情已經把我丟下車了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在追高被套、融資水位滿載時，發在群組自嘲兼提醒同好收手
variations: FOMO 的全名是『把別人的貪婪，變成自己的成本』。
我終於克服了錯過的恐懼，代價是換上了滿倉的恐懼。

en.content:
I wasn't afraid of losing money — I was afraid everyone would win except me.
So I bravely opened a margin position at the very top, and traded my 'fear of missing out' for some very real losses.
Now I'm no longer afraid of missing the rally — because the rally already left me behind.
en.editorNote: For when you chased the top on margin and got left holding the bag — post it to laugh and to warn the group to sit one out
variations: FOMO stands for 'Financing Other people's Money Optimistically.'
I finally conquered my fear of missing out — the price was a fully loaded fear of being stuck in.

items.sourceNote: 命理師預言台股7月崩盤、散戶求神問卜看盤 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
以前看盤我研究基本面、技術面、籌碼面。
現在我研究農民曆、生肖運勢、還有命理師說幾號會崩盤。
畢竟前面三面都讓我賠光了，總得換個面試試看。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合放在半夜睡不著、對著 K 線圖求神問卜的深夜貼文
variations: 散戶的最後一個技術指標，叫做『心誠則靈』。
當你開始相信命理師比分析師準的時候，代表你已經賠到需要奇蹟了。

en.content:
I used to analyze fundamentals, technicals, and order flow.
Now I analyze horoscopes, lucky numbers, and which date the fortune-teller says the crash will hit.
The first three already wiped me out, so I figured I'd try a new discipline.
en.editorNote: For the 2 a.m. post where you're staring at a candlestick chart praying to the market gods
variations: A retail trader's last technical indicator is called 'faith.'
The moment you trust the fortune-teller more than the analyst, you've officially lost enough to need a miracle.

items.sourceNote: 台積電7月法說會成風向球、散戶等法說看方向 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
大家都說『存股』最安穩，我聽話存了兩年。
後來才發現，我存的不是股，是骨——因為越存越剩一把骨頭。
法說會前我還在安慰自己：長期投資嘛，時間是我的朋友。時間點點頭，然後跟大盤一起走了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合存股帳面浮虧、又不甘心停損時，發來自我催眠兼取暖
variations: 存股的精髓，就是把『套牢』兩個字，講得像一種修行。
時間是最好的朋友——前提是你選對股，不然它只是最有耐心的仇人。

en.content:
Everyone says buy-and-hold is the safe way, so I obediently held for two years.
Turns out I wasn't holding a position — I was holding a grudge.
Before the earnings call I kept telling myself: it's long-term investing, time is my friend. Time nodded, then walked off with the index.
en.editorNote: For when your long-term hold is deep in the red and you're too stubborn to cut it — post it to cope and commiserate
variations: The essence of 'buy and hold' is making the words 'stuck in a loss' sound like a spiritual practice.
Time is your best friend — provided you picked the right stock. Otherwise it's just your most patient enemy.

items.sourceNote: 『buy high, cry later』『my portfolio has trust issues』retail meme quotes register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
我的投資紀律非常嚴格：買在最高、抱到最低、停損永遠留到明天。
別人是低買高賣，我是高買、然後哭。
我的對帳單沒有信任問題，它只是很誠實地不相信我。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合設好停損卻永遠不執行、每天喊『明天一定停』的散戶自嘲
variations: 所謂停損點，就是一個會隨著虧損一起往下移動的浮動概念。
我不是不停損，我只是把停損延後到宇宙盡頭。

en.content:
My investing discipline is ironclad: buy at the top, hold to the bottom, and always save the stop-loss for tomorrow.
Other people buy low and sell high. I buy high, then cry.
My portfolio doesn't have trust issues — it's just very honestly decided not to believe in me.
en.editorNote: For the trader who sets a stop-loss every day and never once pulls the trigger
variations: A 'stop-loss level' is just a floating concept that drifts lower alongside your losses.
I do use stop-losses — I've just scheduled mine for the heat death of the universe.

items.sourceNote: 韭菜指標：市場散戶賠錢比例高達90~95% register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
數據說：市場上九成以上的散戶都在賠錢。
我看完鬆了一口氣——原來我不孤單，我只是主流。
能穩定待在九成裡這麼多年，某種程度上，也是一種難得的紀律。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合看到『散戶九成賠錢』統計時，苦中作樂發來自嘲
variations: 我終於在某件事情上贏過大多數人了：賠錢的機率。
別人追求財富自由，我先達成了『賠錢自由』——想賠多少就賠多少。

en.content:
The stats say over 90% of retail traders lose money.
I read that and felt a wave of relief — turns out I'm not alone, I'm just mainstream.
Staying reliably inside that 90% for this many years is, in its own way, a rare kind of discipline.
en.editorNote: For when you see the 'most retail traders lose money' stat and decide to laugh instead of cry
variations: I finally beat the majority at something: the probability of losing money.
Everyone chases financial freedom. I achieved 'losing freedom' first — I can lose as much as I want.

items.sourceNote: 台股融資餘額8,134億破紀錄、兩市首度破8千億 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
新聞：「全市場融資餘額突破八千億，改寫歷史紀錄。」
翻譯成人話：大家不是變有錢了，是一起變敢借了。
我也貢獻了一份心力——用不是我的錢，買了不會漲的股，套住了確實是我的人生。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合看到融資餘額創高的新聞，開槓桿的同好互相取暖用
variations: 融資是一種很浪漫的東西：你先享受買進的快感，之後再慢慢還利息還到懷疑人生。
別人問我有沒有壓身家，我說沒有——我壓的是券商借我的身家。

en.content:
Headline: 'Total margin balance breaks a record high.'
Translation into plain speech: nobody got richer, everyone just got braver about borrowing.
I did my part too — used money that isn't mine to buy a stock that won't go up, and trapped a life that definitely is.
en.editorNote: For when the record margin-balance headline drops and every leveraged friend needs a hug
variations: Margin is a deeply romantic thing: you enjoy the rush of buying first, then slowly pay interest until you question your existence.
People ask if I bet the house. No — I bet the house my broker lent me.

items.sourceNote: 台股4個月漲萬點、違約交割7年新高 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
數據說：違約交割金額創七年新高。
意思是有一群人，買的時候很有信心，交割的時候很沒現金。
我沒違約，我只是把該面對的虧損，很有紀律地分期面對——一天崩潰一點。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合看到違約交割創高新聞，當沖客苦笑轉發
variations: 當沖的精髓就是：早上以為自己是巴菲特，下午發現戶頭是巴掌。
有些人下單前不看價格，交割前才看戶頭——順序剛好相反。

en.content:
The data says settlement defaults just hit a seven-year high.
Meaning: a crowd of people who were very confident when they bought, and very cashless when the bill came due.
I didn't default — I just face my losses on a strict installment plan: a little breakdown each day.
en.editorNote: For the day-trader wincing at the record-defaults headline before hitting share
variations: The essence of day trading: you feel like Warren Buffett in the morning and get slapped by your balance in the afternoon.
Some people check the price before they buy and check their account before settlement — unfortunately, in that order.

items.sourceNote: 巴菲特指標過熱、全球最高 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
專家說巴菲特指標過熱、市場全世界最貴，勸大家先空手。
我聽完鬆一口氣——我早就空手了，只是我的空手不是理性判斷，是沒錢了。
原來別人叫『避險』，我這叫『避無可避』。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合空手看盤的散戶，把被動空手講成主動離場的體面說法
variations: 我跟大師唯一的共識，就是現在不該進場——差別在他是看指標，我是看餘額。
市場過熱的時候我特別冷靜，因為我根本沒有部位可以慌。

en.content:
The experts say the Buffett indicator is overheated, the market is the priciest on earth, and everyone should sit in cash.
I heard that and relaxed — I've been in cash for a while, except my cash position isn't a rational call, it's just being broke.
Turns out what they call 'hedging,' I call 'having no other option.'
en.editorNote: For the sidelined retail trader who reframes being broke as a disciplined exit
variations: The one thing the legends and I agree on is that now is not the time to buy — they read the indicator, I read my balance.
I stay remarkably calm when the market overheats, because I have no position left to panic about.

items.sourceNote: 台股不排除上攻5萬點、散戶想賺又害怕 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
法人喊：台股不排除上攻五萬點。
我內心的兩個小人立刻開會——一個喊『再不上車就沒了』，一個喊『你上一台車還在山下拋錨』。
最後我選擇最安全的做法：邊喊看好，邊什麼都不敢買。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合大盤噴上新高、自己卻卡在想追又怕套的糾結時刻
variations: 所謂五萬點，就是一個我永遠在『下一次』才敢進場的數字。
我對台股的信心非常足，足到我決定用嘴巴支持它就好。

en.content:
The institutions shout: the index could very well charge to fifty thousand.
The two little voices in my head immediately hold a meeting — one yells 'get on board before it leaves,' the other yells 'your last ride is still broken down at the foot of the mountain.'
In the end I go with the safest play: cheer loudly for the rally while being too scared to buy anything.
en.editorNote: For the moment the index melts up to a new high and you're paralyzed between chasing and getting trapped
variations: 'Fifty thousand' is just a number I'll always be brave enough to buy at 'next time.'
My confidence in this market is enormous — so enormous I've decided to support it purely with my mouth.

items.sourceNote: 2026/07 除息旺季 register（台積電除息為市場焦點）；改寫原創，不指涉個股

zh-tw.content:
配息入帳通知跳出來，我開心了三秒。
然後我打開對帳單，發現股價跌掉的幅度剛好是股息的兩倍。
原來所謂「左手換右手」，中間還有人負責從我右手抽一半。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合除息旺季，收到「股利入帳」通知卻完全笑不出來的那一刻
variations: 除息當天最療癒的事，就是把股價那一欄先蓋起來只看股息。
我不是在領股息，我是在分期付款買回自己的錢。

en.content:
The dividend hit my account and I was genuinely happy for three seconds.
Then I opened my statement and saw the share price had dropped exactly twice the dividend.
So 'moving money from one pocket to the other' apparently includes a guy skimming half of it in transit.
en.editorNote: For dividend season, when the 'payment received' notification somehow makes you feel worse
variations: The most soothing thing on an ex-dividend day is covering the price column and looking only at the payout.
I'm not collecting dividends. I'm buying my own money back in installments.

items.sourceNote: 2026/06 大盤單日一度暴跌近 1500 點、「灰犀牛」說法 register；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
大盤單日噴掉一千多點的隔天，我的動態牆上每個人都說自己早就看出來了。
有人說這是灰犀牛，有人說是估值太貴，有人翻出三個月前的貼文當證據。
只有我很誠實：我什麼都沒看出來，而且我當天還加碼。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合大跌後隔天，滿版都是「我早就說過了」的時候發
variations: 崩盤的隔天，全台灣的先知密度會突然衝上歷史新高。
事後看什麼都是灰犀牛，事前我只看得到一片綠色。

en.content:
